Name: LocationSelected
Expression:
VAR _SelectedL = VALUES(Sheet1[Location])
VAR _LHighlight = SELECTEDVALUE('Database'[Location])
VAR _SelectedDB = VALUES(Sheet1[Database])
VAR _DBHighlight = SELECTEDVALUE('Database'[Database])
VAR _SelectedType = VALUES(Sheet1[Substitution Type])
VAR _TypeHighlight = SELECTEDVALUE('Database'[Type])
VAR _SelectedSubstitute = VALUES(Sheet1[Substitution Content (%)])
VAR _SubstituteHighlight = SELECTEDVALUE('Database'[Substitute Content])

VAR _FilteredL = ISFILTERED(Sheet1[Location])
VAR _FilteredDB = ISFILTERED(Sheet1[Database])
VAR _FilteredType = ISFILTERED(Sheet1[Substitution Type])
VAR _FilteredSubstitute = ISFILTERED(Sheet1[Substitution Content (%)])

VAR _Result =
SWITCH(
    TRUE,
    -- 没有筛选时，全部显示默认颜色
    NOT(_FilteredL) && NOT(_FilteredDB) && NOT(_FilteredType) && NOT(_FilteredSubstitute), "#006000",

    -- 当前项在筛选列表中
    (_LHighlight IN _SelectedL || NOT(_FilteredL)) &&
    (_DBHighlight IN _SelectedDB || NOT(_FilteredDB)) &&
    (_TypeHighlight IN _SelectedType || NOT(_FilteredType)) &&
    (_SubstituteHighlight IN _SelectedSubstitute || NOT(_FilteredSubstitute)), "#006000",
    
    "#90EE90"
)
RETURN _Result

Name: Slope_Dark
Expression:
VAR FilteredTable = FILTER(Sheet1, [LocationSelected] = "#004000")
VAR MeanX = AVERAGEX(FilteredTable, Sheet1[Compressive Strength])
VAR MeanY = AVERAGEX(FilteredTable, Sheet1[Carbon Emission Factor])
VAR CovXY = SUMX(FilteredTable, (Sheet1[Compressive Strength] - MeanX) * (Sheet1[Compressive Strength] - MeanY))
VAR VarX_ = SUMX(FilteredTable, (Sheet1[Compressive Strength] - MeanX) ^ 2)
RETURN DIVIDE(CovXY, VarX_, 0)

Name: Intercept_Dark
Expression:

VAR MeanY = AVERAGEX(FILTER(Sheet1, [LocationSelected] = "#004000"), Sheet1[Compressive Strength])
RETURN MeanY - [Slope_Dark] * MeanX

Name: Slope_Database

Name: Intercept_Define

VAR CountNonBlank =
    COUNTROWS(
        FILTER(
            { [x1], [x2], [x3],[x4],[x5],[x6],[x7] },
            [Value] <> 0
        )
    )

VAR mean_X = 
    DIVIDE([x1] + [x2] + [x3]+[x4]+[x5]+[x6]+[x7], CountNonBlank, BLANK())

VAR mean_Y = 
    DIVIDE([y1] + [y2] + [y3]+[y4]+[y5]+[y6]+[y7], CountNonBlank, BLANK())

Return mean_Y - [Slope_Define] * mean_X

Name: Analytical Thrust
Expression:
VAR SoilType = SELECTEDVALUE('Soil Type'[Type])

-- k1 计算
VAR k1_Sandy = 
    (PI() / 4) * (([K_] * [y_] * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 1000 * 9.8 / 1000 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_]) - (1/3) * [f_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [L_] * (2 + [K0_])

VAR k1_Clay = 
    (PI() / 4) * (([K_] * [y_] * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 1000 * 9.8 / 1000 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_])

VAR k1 = 
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        SoilType = "Sandy Soil", k1_Sandy,
        SoilType = "Clay", k1_Clay
    )

-- k2 计算
VAR k2_Sandy = (PI() / 2) * [f_] * ([y_]-9.8) * (1 + [K0_]) * [H_] * [L_]
VAR k2_Clay = PI() * [L_] * [c_]

VAR k2 = 
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        SoilType = "Sandy Soil", k2_Sandy,
        SoilType = "Clay", k2_Clay
    )

-- k3 计算
VAR k3_Sandy = [f_] * [G_] + [ns_] * [Ws_] * [mus_] + [mua_] * [Wa_]
VAR k3_Clay = [ns_] * [Ws_] * [mus_] + [mua_] * [Wa_]

VAR k3 = 
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        SoilType = "Sandy Soil", k3_Sandy,
        SoilType = "Clay", k3_Clay
    )

-- α3 计算
VAR alpha3_Sandy = 
    (PI() / 4) * ([K_] * [y_] * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) /
    ((PI() / 4) * (([K_] * [y_] * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 9.8 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_]) - (1/3) * [f_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [L_] * (2 + [K0_]))

-- α4 计算
VAR alpha4_Sandy = 
    ((PI() / 4) * 9.8 * [H'_] * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_]) /
    ((PI() / 4) * (([K_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 9.8 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_]) - (1/3) * [f_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [L_] * (2 + [K0_]))

-- β1 计算
VAR beta1_Clay = 
    (([K_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_]) * (1 - [hatch_])) /
    (([K_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 9.8 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_])

-- β2 计算
VAR beta2_Clay = 
    (9.8 * [H'_] * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_]) /
    (([K_] * ([y_]-9.8) * [H_] + [K_] * [pq_] + 9.8 * [H'_]) * (1 - [hatch_]) + [pc_] * [hatch_])

-- 选择返回值
VAR alpha3 = IF(SoilType = "Sandy Soil", alpha3_Sandy)
VAR alpha4 = IF(SoilType = "Sandy Soil", alpha4_Sandy)
VAR beta1  = IF(SoilType = "Clay", beta1_Clay)
VAR beta2  = IF(SoilType = "Clay", beta2_Clay)

VAR rc = [v_]/([nc_]*[lc_])

RETURN     
SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        SoilType = "Sandy Soil", (k1 * (alpha3 *rc + alpha4) *[Diameter_TBM_] ^ 2 + k2 * [Diameter_TBM_] +k3)/1000,
        SoilType = "Clay", (k1 * (beta1 *rc + beta2) *[Diameter_TBM_] ^ 2 + k2 * [Diameter_TBM_] +k3)/1000
    )
